panels.title: Disponibilité aujourd’hui
panels.description: Temps de production divisé par le temps où la ligne demandait réellement des impressions. Les périodes sans commande sont exclues.

targets.query:
import "date"
from(bucket: "printer_monitoring")
  |> range(start: date.truncate(t: now(), unit: 1d))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "printer_telemetry" and r._field == "printer_state_code" and (r.classification == "producing" or r.classification == "downtime"))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if r.classification == "producing" then 100.0 else 0.0}))
  |> group() |> mean()

import "date"
from(bucket: "printer_monitoring") |> range(start: date.truncate(t: now(), unit: 1d)) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "marking_event" and r._field == "message_id") |> group() |> count()

import "date"
from(bucket: "printer_monitoring") |> range(start: date.truncate(t: now(), unit: 1d)) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "marking_event" and r._field == "verify_ok") |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if r._value then 100.0 else 0.0})) |> group() |> mean()

import "array"
import "date"
real = from(bucket: "printer_monitoring")
  |> range(start: date.truncate(t: now(), unit: 1d))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "printer_event" and r.event_type == "fault" and r.demanding == "true" and r._field == "duration_s")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: float(v: r._value)}))
fallback = array.from(rows: [{_time: now(), _value: 0.0}])
union(tables: [fallback, real]) |> group() |> sum()

from(bucket: "printer_monitoring")
  |> range(start: -7d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "printer_telemetry" and r._field == "printer_state_code" and (r.classification == "producing" or r.classification == "downtime"))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if r.classification == "producing" then 100.0 else 0.0}))
  |> group(columns: ["printer_id"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "Disponibilité")

panels.title: Répartition du temps
panels.description: Une attente sans commande n’est pas un arrêt. Le signal de demande permet de distinguer ces situations.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "printer_monitoring")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "printer_telemetry" and r._field == "printer_state_code")
  |> group(columns: ["classification"])
  |> count()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: now(), _field: if r.classification == "producing" then "Production" else if r.classification == "downtime" then "Arrêt" else if r.classification == "idle_jet_on" then "Attente, jet actif" else "Sans commande", _value: float(v: r._value)}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])

import "array"
real = from(bucket: "printer_monitoring")
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "printer_event" and r.event_type == "fault" and r._field == "duration_s")
  |> group(columns: ["code"])
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({Cause: if r.code == "E-042" then "Pression d’encre hors plage" else if r.code == "E-051" then "Viscosité de l’encre hors plage" else if r.code == "E-073" then "Buse partiellement obstruée" else if r.code == "E-088" then "Défaut de gouttière" else if r.code == "E-067" then "Capot ouvert" else if r.code == "E-095" then "Déclenchement manqué" else r.code, Secondes: r._value}))
  |> group()
fallback = array.from(rows: [{Cause: "Aucun défaut enregistré", Secondes: 0.0}])
union(tables: [fallback, real]) |> group()

from(bucket: "printer_monitoring")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "marking_event" and r._field == "message_id")
  |> group(columns: ["verify_grade"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 15m, fn: count, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: r.verify_grade}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
